statements.t: Although the revenue impact of individual customer losses has not been material, continued migration to government-operated services or increased reliance on internal agency resources could reduce demand for our solutions and adversely affect future revenues and profitability.
In fiscal 2026, we will continue to focus on the goals identified in our Annual Report on Form 10-K as well as the following:

We expect to incur additional costs in future periods related to our move from a smaller reporting company to an accelerated filer, including increased external audit fees, consulting services, additional personnel and other compliance-related expenditures.

We also expect to incur certain compensation costs associated with previously approved employee incentive arrangements that are contingent upon the final resolution of the protest process with respect to our CWMS 3.0 award.

We expect to use net proceeds, if any, from the ATM Offering over time as a source for general corporate purposes, including potentially expanding existing businesses, acquiring businesses and investing in other business opportunities.

We anticipate increased technology investments beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026 and continuing into 2027, primarily to enhance the security and capabilities of our identity management solutions, including upgrades to support post-quantum cryptography, as well as broader cybersecurity and infrastructure improvements.
We expect to fund these investments primarily through available cash and, where appropriate, equipment financing arrangements.
Based on currently available information and anticipated business requirements, the Company presently expects capital expenditures during the remainder of 2026 to approximate $0.4 million.

In addition, the Company currently anticipates capital expenditures during 2027 could approximate $2.0 million, primarily to support anticipated customer programs, technology infrastructure and other strategic initiatives.

As a result of the Company's transition to accelerated filer status, the Company expects increased operating cash expenditures associated with compliance with the auditor attestation requirements of Section 404(b) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act during the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
